explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/485 (Erdős–Rényi): with f(k) the minimum number of terms of P² over P with exactly k nonzero terms, is f(k) → ∞? Yes, by Schinzel, improved by Schinzel–Zannier. f is the sInf over P ∈ ℚ[X] with support size k of the support size of P², and the set is nonempty for every k, e.g. via sums of k monomials. The statement asserts f → ∞. Faithful.
